_comment: PRD section 2's performance budgets. Rule R-E: budgets are laws — a gate is
never edited to make a build pass. If a change cannot meet one, the change
is wrong or the budget needs an ADR; both are decisions, not edits.
Gates are hard failures. Targets are what PRD 2 actually aims for: a run
between target and gate passes and says so, so drift is visible before it

idle_ram_mib.conditions: 2-minute settle after GUI login, 4 GB VM (PRD 2)
idle_ram_mib.note: 1.1 GiB = 1126 MiB. Measured as MemTotal - MemAvailable.

boot_seconds.conditions: cold boot, power-on to login screen, virtio SSD VM (PRD 2)
boot_seconds.note: Read from systemd's own firmware+loader+kernel+userspace total.
